criteria.quote: Clefairy is rare. So why do groups gather?
criteria.revision: Open with the evidence-backed contradiction more vividly: "Clefairy is rarely seen—yet on every full-moon night, groups gather from all over to dance."

criteria.quote: At dawn, tired Clefairy sleep nestled together in quiet mountains.
Why do rare Clefairy gather from all over under full moons?
criteria.revision: Make the unanswered question more precise without implying an unsupported cause: "What happens when this rarely seen Pokémon gathers under a full moon?"

criteria.quote: Clefairy is rare. So why do groups gather? / Full moons make this difficult-to-find Pokémon easier to spot. / Their gathering surrounds the area with an abnormal magnetic field.
criteria.revision: Move from rarity directly into the gathering, then reveal the magnetic field as the escalation: "On full-moon nights, groups gather from all over to dance—while the surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field."

criteria.quote: Their gathering surrounds the area with an abnormal magnetic field.
criteria.revision: Delay and sharpen the reveal: after showing the dancing groups, say, "But the gathering comes with one stranger detail: the surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field."

criteria.quote: RARE, THEN GROUPS GATHER / FULL MOON MAKES IT EASIER / A FULL-MOON GATHERING
criteria.revision: Combine the overlapping rarity and visibility beats, then use the saved scene for a distinct moonlight detail supported by the research: "Bathed in moonlight, Clefairy's wings glow faintly, and it rises without flapping."

criteria.quote: The full moon reveals not one Clefairy, but a dancing gathering surrounded by an abnormal magnetic field before dawn brings mountain sleep.
criteria.revision: Correct the timing and give the ending a fuller resolution: "At dawn, the tired Clefairy return to quiet mountain retreats and sleep nestled together—the full-moon gathering has ended."

criteria.quote: Would you seek the dance, or avoid its magnetic field?
criteria.revision: Remove the unsupported implication that the magnetic field is dangerous and ground the split in the research: "Would you believe a gathering of dancing Clefairy brings happiness—or is it simply a rare sight worth seeing?"
